summary.object_en: Maintenance of the OT/industrial cybersecurity of Aguas de Lorca (municipal water utility, essential-service operator) in 3 lots: (1) IT/OT network segregation firewalls in HA, licences and support; (2) OT anomaly-detection probe; (3) managed security service (SOC level 1 and 2) integrated with the Veolia group SOC.
summary.object_es: Servicio de mantenimiento de las medidas de ciberseguridad y operaciones de mantenimiento para operador de servicio esencial: Lote 1 segregación de redes IT/OT (firewall), Lote 2 detección de anomalías (sonda), Lote 3 operación y mantenimiento (SOC N1/N2).
summary.contract_type: Servicios, procedimiento abierto URGENTE, no armonizado; contracting entity is a public company (S.A.)
summary.duration: Lot 1: 4 years; Lot 2: 1 year; Lot 3: 4 years

lots.name: Mantenimiento proyecto segregación de redes IT/OT – Firewall
Mantenimiento proyecto detección de anomalías – Sonda
Servicio de operación y mantenimiento (SOC N1/N2)

eligibility.requirement_en: Turnover in the best of the last 3 closed years ≥ 1.5 × the contract's average annual estimated value (same rule for each lot).
eligibility.quote: deberá ser al menos una vez y media el valor estimado anual medio del contrato.

eligibility.requirement_en: Similar work in the last 3 years with, in the best year, an accumulated amount ≥ 70% of the contract's average annual value, proven by signed and stamped client certificates.
eligibility.quote: sea igual o superior al 70 por ciento de la anualidad media del contrato.

eligibility.requirement_en: ISO 27001 (or proof of work under that standard), ISO 9001, ENS certification (or proof of ENS work), and official Spanish partner/distributor status for the offered products held for at least 6 months.
eligibility.threshold: ISO 27001 + ISO 9001 + ENS + vendor partner ≥ 6 months
eligibility.alternative: ISO 27001 and ENS can be replaced by certified work in those frameworks; ISO 9001 and partnership cannot
eligibility.quote: Acreditar que es distribuidor oficial (partnership) en España de los servicios o suministros ofertados

eligibility.requirement_en: Technicians (can be one person) with, in the last 12 months: ≥ 4 OT security O&M services in the water-cycle sector; ≥ 3 OT cybersecurity projects in the water-cycle sector; and an industrial OT project ≥ 60% of this tender's value. Plus OT security certification from ISA (62443) or SANS.
eligibility.threshold: 4 water-sector O&M services + 3 water-sector projects in 12 months
eligibility.quote: Al menos un técnico con experiencia en al menos 4 servicios de operación y mantenimiento

eligibility.requirement_en: No subcontracting allowed: you must deliver everything yourself.
Scope includes integrating all system data with the Veolia group SOC; hardware components need 24x7 on-site manufacturer support with 4-hour response.
eligibility.quote: el soporte in situ deberá quedar cubierto con el servicio de 24x7 con un tiempo máximo de respuesta de 4h

award_criteria.name: Oferta económica (each lot)
award_criteria.how_scored_en: Proportional: (lowest total ÷ your total) × 80, using the sum of unit prices × listed quantities.

award_criteria.name: Docencia universitaria en el último año (lots 1 and 3)
award_criteria.how_scored_en: 5 points per assigned team member who taught university courses in cybersecurity, networks or industry 4.0 in the last year (max 10).
award_criteria.quote: Docencia universitaria durante el ultimo año, en materia relacionada con ciberseguridad

award_criteria.name: Nivel de partner de Palo Alto Networks (lots 1 and 3)
award_criteria.how_scored_en: 10 points for at least Palo Alto Networks 'Innovator' partner level.
award_criteria.quote: Nivel de partner de Palo Alto Networks -Lote 1

award_criteria.name: Miembro de partner de Claroty (lot 2)
award_criteria.how_scored_en: 20 points for Claroty 'FOCUS' partner level; lot 2 is otherwise price only (80).

price.formula: Pi = (Ofmin (€) / Ofi (€)) · Pmax,ec, with Ofmin = lowest offer, Ofi = offer i, Pmax,ec = 80; totals from unit prices × quantities in the offer annex; rounded to 2 decimals.
price.formula_explained_en: Inverse-proportional: the cheapest bid gets 80 points; a bid 10% more expensive gets about 72.7. Price dominates (80 of 100), and the remaining points are vendor-partner badges and university teaching.
price.abnormally_low_rule: Art. 85 RGLCAP thresholds (see the cemetery tender for the full rule). Bidders flagged are given a justification step; if not justified they are excluded. Group companies are treated per art. 149 LCSP.
price.definitive_guarantee: 5% of the awarded price per lot (excl. VAT)
price.quote: Fórmula para puntuar la oferta económica de cada uno de los lotes

review_notes: TEXT EXTRACTION WARNING: in this PDF the checkboxes and the scoring tables are drawn as images, so plain text extraction reads every checkbox as 'SI'. Checked visually on the page images: variants NO (p.6), price revision NO (p.6), judgement criteria NO (p.6), personal data processing NO (p.3), integrated multi-lot offer NO (p.3), planned modifications NO (p.13). Production extraction must use page images (the Claude API reads both).

SCORING WEIGHTS ARE ONLY IN TABLE IMAGES (p.6–7). Cited here from the PLACSP structured data, which matches the images: price 80 + university teaching 10 + Palo Alto partner 10 (lots 1, 3); price 80 + Claroty partner 20 (lot 2).

INCUMBENT / ECOSYSTEM SIGNALS: renewal of existing installed systems ('continuar con los servicios ... que ya se disponían', PCAP p.2); scope requires integration with the Veolia group SOC (PPT p.6); scoring rewards partners of the exact vendors already installed (Palo Alto, Claroty). Realistic only for a Palo Alto/Claroty partner with water-sector OT references.
VERY NARROW TEAM REQUIREMENT: technicians with 4 water-sector OT O&M services and 3 water-sector OT projects in the last 12 months (PCAP p.11). Few firms in Spain qualify.
AMBIGUITY – Lot 3 Level 1: the team 'operará ... en modalidad 8x5' but capabilities include 'Monitorización continua 24x7' (PPT p.23). Clarify before pricing.
Urgent procedure: shortened timelines throughout. Prices are unit prices × quantities; check every line of the offer annex.
Solvency thresholds in the eligibility section are computed from the pliego rule and lot values, not stated explicitly.
